citationCompleteness.rule: Each flat judgment includes decisive source references and literal supporting quotes.

interpretation.result: The flat and faceted AI reviews agree on only 2 of 6 exact dispositions. Four directional mismatches are a large descriptive sensitivity signal in this calibration sample.
interpretation.causalLimit: Different reviewers judged the two representations, and the faceted reviewer disclosed incidental aggregate exposure after forming judgments. The design cannot isolate representation effects from reviewer effects.
interpretation.powerLimit: Six calibration cases are not a powered effectiveness sample and do not establish population-level equivalence or a winning Dream arm.
interpretation.qualificationLimit: Flat ACCEPT means qualified as a bounded experiment on the flat source-stage evidence, not global novelty, implementation success, or beneficial outcome. The separate unblinded novelty review remains 0 of 3 qualified representatives and controls current downstream eligibility.
interpretation.acceptanceLimit: This result is AI/offline calibration, not independent human validation, held-out confirmation, downstream experiment evidence, product acceptance, or shipment approval.
